description_en: Call the `ListTagResources` API to list the tags associated with your applications
description_zh: 调用ListTagResources接口查询应用和标签的对应关系
kebab_example: aliyun sae list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type application --next-token A2RN --resource-ids '["d42921c4-5433-4abd-8075-0e536f8b****"]' --tags '[{"key":"k1","value":"v1"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Only `application` is supported
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: A query can return a maximum of 50 results. If the number of results exceeds this limit, the response includes a NextToken. To retrieve the next page of results, pass this token in your next request
parameters.help_zh: 一次查询最多返回50条结果，当结果超过50条时，会同时返回一个NextToken，下一次查询使用该NextToken即可查询前50条结果之外的结果
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The resource IDs, specified as a JSON array of strings. This parameter is required if the Tags parameter is not specified
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID。可填写多个资源ID，用英文逗号（,）分隔。当您未输入Tags参数时必填
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en:
The tags used to filter resources. This parameter is required if the ResourceIds parameter is not specified. A tag is a key-value pair.

key: The tag key. The key can be 1 to 128 characters in length.

value: The tag value. The value can be 1 to 128 characters in length.

Tag keys and tag values are case-sensitive. If you specify multiple tags, the operation returns only resources that have all the specified tags.

A tag key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
标签键值对，当您未输入ResourceIds参数时必填。取值说明如下：
key：标签键，字符长度范围[1,128]。
value：标签值，字符长度范围[1,128]。

区分大小写。如果指定多个标签，则会为指定资源同时创建并绑定多个标签。同一个资源上的同一个标签键只能对应一个标签值。如果您尝试添加已有标签键，则对应的标签值会更新为新值。

不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
parameters.name: tags
